save_tensor_to_pt_file: create a pytorch tensor and save it to a .pt file using torch.save
save_tensor_with_key: save a pytorch tensor wrapped in a dictionary with a named key to a .pt file
create_fortran_numpy_array: create a 3d numpy array with fortran contiguous memory layout using np.asfortranarray
convert_numpy_to_tensor: convert a fortran contiguous numpy array to a pytorch tensor using torch.from_numpy
save_fortran_tensor_to_pth: save a fortran layout pytorch tensor to a .pth file using torch.save
